content.short: Storm Trade is the first decentralized derivatives exchange on TON, offering perpetual futures with high leverage.
content.description: Storm Trade is a pioneering decentralized derivatives exchange (DEX) built natively on the TON blockchain. It allows users to trade perpetual futures for a wide range of assets, including cryptocurrencies, commodities, and stocks, with leverage up to 500x. Designed to provide a professional trading experience directly within Telegram, Storm Trade features high-speed execution, low fees, and deep liquidity. It is a cornerstone of the TON DeFi ecosystem, empowering users to execute sophisticated trading strategies in a non-custodial and secure environment.
content.meta: Trade perpetuals with high leverage on Storm Trade, the premier TON derivatives DEX. Explore on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
